metaTitle: Mercedes-Benz Engine Rebuild Process | Mercedes Garage
metaDescription: Our complete 10-step engine rebuild process for Mercedes-Benz: from vehicle arrival and diagnosis to strip-down, machining, reassembly, testing, and road test.
lede: Our complete 10-step rebuild process — from arrival to road test — performed in-house with manufacturer-grade equipment and expertise.

blocks.html: Our engine rebuild service is a complete, systematic process that restores your Mercedes-Benz engine to factory-spec condition. Every step is carried out in-house at our Billericay workshop by our experienced technicians.

items: **Initial diagnosis** – full vehicle and engine assessment to confirm the required work
**Engine removal** – safe extraction using specialised lifting equipment
**Full strip-down** – complete disassembly to inspect every component
**Cleaning and inspection** – parts are cleaned and measured to determine reusability
**Precision machining** – cylinder boring/honing, deck surfacing, crank grinding, and align honing (all in-house)
**Parts sourcing and quality check** – we supply genuine or high-quality OEM-equivalent components
**Reassembly** – new bearings, seals, piston rings, and timing components fitted to exact torque specifications
**Final assembly and torquing** – all fasteners tightened to manufacturer-specified values
**Engine testing** – oil pressure, compression, and leak-down tests to verify performance
**Refit and road test** – engine reinstalled, fluids filled, and a full road test to confirm drivability

blocks.html: Throughout the process, we document each stage and keep you informed. Our goal is a reliable, long-lasting engine that performs like new.
Our rebuild pricing is fixed per engine type. The table below shows our starting prices – your final quote may vary based on the specific condition and required parts.

steps.title: Arrival & Diagnosis
steps.body: Vehicle arrives, we perform a full diagnostic check to confirm the scope of the rebuild.

steps.title: Engine Removal
steps.body: We safely remove the engine using a hoist, disconnecting all ancillaries and wiring.

steps.title: Full Strip-Down
steps.body: Engine is completely disassembled – block, crank, rods, head, valvetrain, and all internal parts.

steps.title: Cleaning & Inspection
steps.body: All components are cleaned and measured. We determine which parts can be reused.

steps.title: Precision Machining
steps.body: In-house machining: cylinder boring/honing, deck surfacing, crank grinding, align honing.

steps.title: Parts Sourcing
steps.body: We order all required new components – bearings, seals, rings, timing gear – to OEM quality.

steps.title: Reassembly
steps.body: Engine is reassembled with new parts, following manufacturer torque sequences and specifications.

steps.title: Final Assembly & Torquing
steps.body: All fasteners are torqued to exact values, and critical clearances are verified.

steps.title: Engine Testing
steps.body: Oil pressure, compression, and leak-down tests are performed to confirm performance.

steps.title: Refit & Road Test
steps.body: Engine is reinstalled, fluids filled, and a full road test ensures everything is perfect.

items.q: What are the 10 steps in your engine rebuild process?
items.a: 1. Vehicle arrival and initial diagnosis. 2. Engine removal. 3. Full strip-down. 4. Cleaning and inspection. 5. Machining (boring, honing, grinding). 6. Parts sourcing and quality check. 7. Reassembly with new bearings, seals, piston rings, timing components. 8. Final assembly and torquing to spec. 9. Engine testing (oil pressure, compression, leak-down). 10. Refit and road test.

items.q: How long does a typical Mercedes engine rebuild take?
items.a: We aim for a 3-5 working day turnaround from arrival at our workshop, subject to parts availability and machining requirements. The full process is managed in-house to maintain quality and speed.
Yes. We have a fully equipped machine shop on-site, capable of cylinder boring and honing, deck resurfacing, align honing, and crankshaft grinding. This ensures we control every stage of the rebuild.

items.q: What warranty do you offer on a rebuilt engine?
items.a: All our engine rebuilds come with a 12-month, unlimited-mileage warranty covering parts and labour, giving you complete peace of mind.

items.q: Can you rebuild AMG and V12 engines?
items.a: Absolutely. We have specialist tooling and experience with all Mercedes engine families, including AMG V8s (M156, M157, M177) and the V12 M275. We treat each engine with the care it requires.
